verified.analysis: The catalyst is real, dated and forward. The October 2026 topline has not fired. It is not a macro bet, and it is not harvested: the stock fell 17.7% on 9/23/26 after the CEO cautioned that some bipolar mania patients might worsen, so expectations have been reset lower. The 2026 epilepsy/FOS program and about $436M of cash (a stale figure) cap the downside, which leaves roughly +31% to the pre-warning level against roughly -22% to the 52-week low (about 1.4:1). Two things keep this at WATCH, not ACTIVE: management itself flagged a possible negative signal, and a readout inside about 3 weeks may land before a bi-weekly pipeline can act. Gaps: I could not find the exact readout date, the trial size or the endpoint, and the cash figure was not re-checked against the latest 10-Q. Numerator provenance is not applicable (no preferred stock or waterfall; the upside is a binary re-rate, not a derived SoP).

verified.analysis: The Kilmer buyout is real and done (C$4.35B, closed 2026-10-01). The forward event is the minority-stake sale of the >C$25B sports/media entity by H1 2027, which is management intent with no named buyer. Capital structure re-derived from the Q2 2026 balance sheet (CAD): total debt C$45.7B, net debt C$44.0B before the C$4.35B buyout cash, and C$6.3B of minority interest ranking ahead of the common (mostly the Blackstone-led wireless-backhaul structured equity, whose redemption and step-up terms were NOT checked here; that is a gap). Common equity is only about C$22.5B (US$16.1B) inside an EV of about C$77B, so the waterfall does support the upside: if a sale crystallises C$25B against roughly C$15B implied, that is about +C$10B, or about +40% gross on the equity, though leverage cuts both ways. Score 5 / WATCH rather than ACTIVE: there is no counterparty yet, the guided date is 6-9 months out, the story is widely covered, and the telecom stub is deteriorating (52-week low) and could swamp the SoP gain.
